revision_history.rationale: Retain each genuine 10 Hz simulator-time MID-360 cloud in RViz until the next real arrival, close the zero-live-count audit blind spot, and provide a verified smaller transfer copy without changing navigation inputs.
revision_history.confirmed_root_cause: The simulator produces nonempty MID-360 scans at 10 Hz simulator time, but the approximately 0.051 real-time factor yields wall-clock gaps much longer than the RViz 0.4-second decay. The display expires between genuine messages, while live auditing is disabled and can pass with zero live-cloud observations.

runs.result: Generated 101 scans and observed 99 live clouds, but the Foxy install tree still carried require_live_lidar=false. The new fail-closed native audit rejected the run; source/install rebuild was required.
runs.evidence_scope: Full 6.6 GiB run preserved remotely; lightweight audit/log/identity evidence recovered locally.

runs.result: The rebuilt native audit passed and video visibility was 251/251 with zero blank frames, but only 95 of 101 generated scans were observed (0.940594), below the 0.95 coverage gate.
runs.evidence_scope: Full 6.7 GiB run preserved remotely; lightweight audit/log/identity evidence recovered locally.

runs.result: Starting the audit node before robot_state_publisher did not remove the generic runner startup race; coverage remained 95/101 (0.940594), so the hard gate failed.
runs.evidence_scope: Full 6.9 GiB run preserved remotely; lightweight audit/log/identity evidence recovered locally.

runs.result: A separate prestarted observer reached READY but its isolated ROS 2 container received zero clouds; the unsupported cross-container DDS path was rejected and removed.
